THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land descibed as following name depicted in the Advance Tracing No. B/HLE/2019/393 dated 30.06.2021 of prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village called Wellewela (F.V.P. 18), in Pallegama (55A) Grama Niladhari Division, in Dehivinipalatha Korale Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Hali Ela in Badulla District of Uva Province and bounded as follows.
01. Lot ‘A’ – Pitahaellepathana - Extent: 0.1114 Hectare
North: Lot Nos. 216 and 257 in F.V.P. 18; East: Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18; South: Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18 and Lot B; West: Lot Nos. 215 and 216 in F.V.P. 18.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Pitahaellepathana - Extent: 0.0313 Hectare
North: Lot Nos. 214, 215 in F.V.P. 18 and Lot A; East: Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18; South: Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18 and Lot C; West: Lot C and Lot No. 214 in F.V.P. 18.
03. Lot ‘C’ – Pitahaellepathana - Extent: 0.0301 Hectare

North: Lot No. 214 in F.V.P. 18 and Lot B; East: Lot B and Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18; South: Lot No. 258 in F.V.P. 18; West: Lot Nos. 258 and 214 in F.V.P. 18. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
